correctness.rationale: Writing R=f⊗w and polarizing RB yields w²=μw, fL_w=μf/2. For w=(a,u), nondegenerate bilinear form forces B(u,u)=a², f(1)=0, f(u)=0, u≠0, thus R²=R(1)=0. Projective w lies on smooth quadric and each line permits q^(n-1)-1 nonzero covectors orthogonal to u. Standard finite-field quadratic Gauss sums give the stated even/odd image-type counts and determinant η-dependence. I independently enumerated projective quadrics and nil/idempotent counts in six q,n,determinant configurations, and verified the number of allowed covectors for all q=3,n=4 quadric points. The rank-(n-1) annihilator bundle punctured at zero is smooth geometrically irreducible dimension 2n-2; the result only characterizes the reduced locus.
